name: hiran-skills
description: Hiran Patel's personal Claude skills library for CV tailoring and job search workflows

plugins.name: cv-tailoring
plugins.description: Tailors a CV to a job description: parses the JD, checks gaps against a master fact file (asking about anything addressable), scores ATS keyword coverage, drafts profile/skills/bullets, runs an independent review, and generates a DOCX saved to a local output folder.
